name: newsletter-template
description: Self-hosted serverless newsletter on Cloudflare — signup, one-click unsubscribe, and send campaigns to your own list. Bring your own email sender.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Password that protects your send page (/admin). Use a long, random string.

FROM_NAME.description: The name your emails are sent from, e.g. "Jane's Newsletter".

FROM_EMAIL.description: The address your emails are sent from, once you connect an email provider in src/email.ts.

DOUBLE_OPT_IN.description: Set to "true" to require subscribers to confirm via a link before they're added (needs email configured). Default "false" (single opt-in).

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional. Public Cloudflare Turnstile site key for bot protection on the signup form. Leave blank to disable. Pair with the TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY secret.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile secret key (verifies signups server-side). Leave blank to disable.

RSS_AUTOSEND.description: Optional. Set to "true" to automatically email subscribers when a new post appears in your RSS feed. Needs RSS_FEED_URL, PUBLIC_URL and email configured. Default "false".

RSS_FEED_URL.description: Optional. Your blog's RSS or Atom feed URL, checked on a schedule for new posts (used with RSS_AUTOSEND).

PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional. Your Worker's public URL (e.g. https://your-worker.workers.dev). Required for RSS auto-send so unsubscribe links in scheduled emails are absolute.
